description: Use when the user wants to sell tickets they hold on the XP marketplace -- 'sell my two seats for Friday', 'list section 104 row C', 'put my tickets up'. Creates the listing that buyers (other fans on XP) then make an offer on; the seller answers those with accept_offer and reject_offer. Tickets are not transferred now -- transfer happens after an offer is accepted. Ask the seller whether the seats are accessible (ADA), obstructed view or standing room only: all three are required, never assumed. Two-phase: confirm=false previews so the section, row, seats and those three can be read back to the user, confirm=true creates it. A new listing is REVIEWED before it goes live. The result carries listing_state -- live, in_review or not_accepted -- and only `live` means buyers can see it. Do not tell the user their tickets are for sale unless it says live. Requires auth.

ask_per_ticket_usd.description: Optional asking price per ticket in dollars. Omit to invite offers with no anchor.

confirm.description: False (default) previews. True creates the listing.

event_id.description: Event identifier from search_market or search_events.

ga.description: True for general admission with no seat numbers.

is_ada.description: Required. True if accessible (ADA) seating. Ask the seller; never assume.

is_obstructed_view.description: Required. True if the view is obstructed. Ask the seller; never assume.

is_sro.description: Required. True if standing room only. Ask the seller; never assume.

quantity.description: How many tickets are being listed together.

row.description: Row, e.g. C. Omit for general admission.

section.description: Section name exactly as the venue prints it, e.g. 104.

name: create_listing
title: List Tickets for Sale
